{{Top}}
'''Ceramic''' was a substance used for a variety of purposes.

==History==
===Arms and Armor===
Composite ceramics were used in the creation of some [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. Layers of composite ceramics were used in the [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]] worn by [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] wielding [[Emperor-4 beam tube]]s. The ceramics helped the blast vest to absorb and dissipate kinetic energy from high-impact projectiles.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> [[Slugthrower/Legends|Slugthrower]] [[Slug/Legends|ammunition]] could be constructed of ceramic.<ref name="EGWT" />

===Vehicles===
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[MT/191 drop-ship]] was typically covered in [[VACX]], a protective coating, before deployment to allow the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to survive the high-friction [[Temperature/Legends|temperatures]] of a powerdive into a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] captured a few of these vessels but, as VACX coating was difficult to come by, instead coated the [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] with a mix of [[air-foam]]/[[Silica/Legends|silicate]] ceramic. The homebrew coating seemed to be the most effective compared to other mixtures, through trials continued.<ref name="Handbook">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>

[[Sling racer]]s, wind-propelled [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] used in the sport of [[sling racing]], were very lightweight, built from advanced ultra-light metal alloys and ceramics.<ref name="SOTEPG">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

===Tatooine===
During the period of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Shalo's Cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] adorned its interior with ceramic statuettes of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] and [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], two local [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Rebirth">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref> Two [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] later, the young [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Kitaya Shuul]] once used a ceramic bowl while begging near the entrance of the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on Tatooine.<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>
